zh: 值域里只有d=hi−lo+1个数，严格上升段和严格下降段各自最多用到d个不同值且共享峰值，所以长度必须在3到2d−1之间，否则无解。
峰值取hi总不吃亏。为了让第一项尽量大，上升段要尽量短：峰右侧最多放d−1个数，所以上升边数至少是n−d，同时至少为1。
令p=max(1,n−d)：从hi−p开始每次加1直到hi（共p+1个数），然后从hi−1开始每次减1，补满剩下的n−p−1个位置；有解时先输出n再输出序列，无解输出−1。
en: The range holds only d = hi - lo + 1 values; the strictly rising part and the strictly falling part each use at most d distinct values and share the peak, so the length must be between 3 and 2d - 1, otherwise there is no solution.

Putting the peak at hi never hurts. To make the first item as large as possible the rising part should be as short as possible: the right side of the peak holds at most d - 1 numbers, so there are at least n - d rising edges, and at least 1.

Let p = max(1, n - d): start at hi - p and add 1 each step up to hi (p + 1 numbers), then go down by 1 from hi - 1 to fill the remaining n - p - 1 positions; when a solution exists print n and then the sequence, otherwise print -1.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let d=hi-lo+1. At least 3 positions are needed and at most 2d-1. To make the first item as large as possible, use the shortest feasible rising phase: the number of rising edges is p=max(1,n-d); start at hi-p, increase one by one up to hi, then decrease one by one.

## Correctness

Raising the peak to hi does not reduce the available room and can improve the lexicographic order. The right side of the peak can hold at most d-1 elements, so the left side needs at least n-d rising edges, and at least 1; taking the smallest p maximizes the first item hi-p. With the first item fixed, each next number is taken as large as possible, but p rising positions must be kept before reaching hi, so the sequence can only increase by 1 at each step; after the peak, decreasing by 1 each time maximizes each corresponding position, and the length bound guarantees it never drops below lo.

## Complexity

Time O(n), output space O(n).
